🚢 Week two, The Tir Na Nog
content:
Cato has flashes of the past months with Arc. The first night on the roof together. Seeing the moon like he never had before. The joy when he learned that he was going to be sharing a room with them. Their dance in this very room together. His hands on their waist their calm and sweet voice. "Will you marry me?"
It flashes to a scene of them laying in bed together. "I love you." is said in Arcs voice. "I love you too." "What about Zephyr."-Arc "Zephyr it is."-Cato 
It flashes again. The scene just 20 minutes ago. Them laying in bed together. "I wo-" They're cut off by the alarm-Arc 
"No stay please." He reaches his arm out to keep Arc from going
"I love you, and I won't do anything stupid, I promise."
